page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.20xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 80 dedicated vCPUs from the Intel Xeon 8269CY processor family, operating at a base clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The instance is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 4.8 GB of RAM per core.

This server configuration does not include bundled local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system and application deployment. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 25 Gbps to support data transfer requirements. There are no integrated graphics processing units or complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this configuration.

The ecs.hfg6.20xlarge offers a high-frequency compute profile with a balanced memory-to-core ratio, making it qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads that require high single-core performance alongside multi-threaded capabilities without the overhead of specialized GPU hardware. Appropriate workloads include enterprise application hosting, web serving, database management systems, and general-purpose compute tasks that benefit from dedicated CPU allocation and high clock speeds.
